The two terms are defined in the `useVisit` hook's JSDoc in openmrs-esm-core and implemented in the same file. The O3 docs site mentions "active visit" in several places but never defines "current visit" or contrasts the two.

**Active visit:** the patient's most recent visit with no end date. The hook fetches `/visit?patient=…&includeInactive=false` and picks the result whose `stopDatetime === null`. A non-null active visit generally means the patient is in the facility (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useVisit.ts:87-90`).

**Current visit:** the active visit, unless a retrospective visit has been manually selected in the visit context store. In that case the retrospective visit is current. If there is neither an active visit nor a selected retrospective visit, there is no current visit. `currentVisitIsRetrospective` says whether the current visit is the retrospective one (`useVisit.ts:92-95`, `useVisit.ts:138`). The hook's own tests pin this down: an ended visit yields a null `activeVisit` and null `currentVisit`, and a retrospective visit with no active visit becomes `currentVisit` with `currentVisitIsRetrospective` true (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useVisit.test.ts:137-245`).

**Context side effects:** when there is an active visit for the store's patient and no manual selection, the hook sets it as the visit context. When the current visit ends while it was the current one, the context is cleared (`useVisit.ts:98-117`).

**Deprecation:** `currentVisit` and `currentVisitIsRetrospective` are marked `@deprecated` outside the patient chart, which should use `visitContext` instead (`useVisit.ts:18-28`).

**Where it is used in the chart:** `activeVisit` drives the stop/delete visit buttons (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/stop-visit.component.tsx:18-28`, `delete-visit.component.tsx:18-25`). The chart's visit cache mutations treat a visit without `stopDatetime` as active when updating the current-visit cache (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/visit-mutations.ts:93-125`). The revalidation helper treats `includeInactive=false` keys as current-visit keys (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/revalidation-utils.ts:9-16`).

**Docs:** the O3 docs mention the terms without defining them: `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/workspaces/launching-workspaces.mdx:39,57` (workspaces requiring an active visit) and `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/configure-ward-management.mdx:197` (observation tags limited to the current visit). The docs repo has no explicit definition, so the JSDoc in `useVisit.ts` is the only documentation of the distinction.

I did not read the rest of `useVisitContextStore.ts`, so how the retrospective selection is stored is unverified.
